# Supervised learning for factor investing

Teaching material (**R** code) for **introductory** courses on supervised learning applied to factor investing.
:::

## Sessions

HTML notebooks and PDF slides for each session.

::: sessions
1. **Economic foundations**: asset pricing anomalies, characteristics-based investing [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S1_Foundations.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S1_Foundations.pdf)]{.links}
1. **Portfolio strategies**: portfolio back-testing framework [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S2_Portfolio.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S2_Portfolio.pdf)]{.links}
1. **Penalized regressions & sparse portfolios**: penalised regressions for minimum variance portfolios and for robust forecasts [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S3_Lasso.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S3_LASSO.pdf)]{.links}
1. **Data preparation**: feature engineering and labelling with a focus on categorical data [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S4_Data.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S4_Data.pdf)]{.links}
1. **Decision trees**: simple trees, random forests and boosted trees [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S5_Trees.nb.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S5_Trees.pdf)]{.links}
1. **Neural networks**: multilayer perceptron and recurrent networks (**G**ated **R**ecurrent **U**nits) [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S6_NN.nb.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S6_NN.pdf)]{.links}
1. **Validating & tuning**: performance metrics and hyper-parameter adjustment [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S7_Validation.nb.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S7_Tuning.pdf)]{.links}
1. **Extensions**: SVMs, ensemble learning, interpretability and deflated Sharpe ratios [[Notebook](files/ML_course/S8_Extensions.nb.html) [Slides](files/ML_course/S8_Extensions.pdf)]{.links}
:::

## Material

Datasets in R format (they end in 2025):

- [**Base** (small)](https://github.com/shokru/coqueret.github.io/blob/master/files/ML_course/data_new.RData): 30 firms, 7 features, year 2000 onwards
- [**Large**](https://github.com/shokru/coqueret.github.io/raw/master/files/ML_course/SPX_macro.RData): ~500 firms (S&P500), 20 features (including GHG emissions across the 3 scopes) and 4 macro variables, from year 1991 onwards
